subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw accept this Wear OS companion as a first-party Android app surface, and who owns finishing the security, CI, proof, and release obligations before merge?
rationale: The PR is a broad new first-party app with auth, gateway, proxy, release, and validation consequences; automation can identify blockers, but only maintainers can decide whether core should carry and maintain the app surface.

options.title: Adopt after hardening
options.body: Keep this PR open as the canonical Wear OS feature, require the security/CI/license/proof fixes, and have an Android owner sponsor the rebase and final review.

options.title: Replace with a maintainer branch
options.body: Use this branch as source work and open a narrower maintainer-owned replacement branch that preserves contributor credit while resolving the dirty base and review blockers.

options.title: Decline first-party Wear for now
options.body: Close the PR as not planned if maintainers do not want to own a bundled Wear app and prefer a separate app/plugin direction instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt after hardening
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open as the canonical Wear OS feature, require the security/CI/license/proof fixes, and have an Android owner sponsor the rebase and final review.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus is the live assignee and has adjacent Android history, making them the best available routing owner for the product/ownership question.
